exposure: Implementation of the World Health Organization Safe Childbirth Checklist (SCC)
outcome: Compliance with MgSO4 prescription recommendations (underuse and overuse)
Use of MgSO4 in women with preeclampsia with severe features
cohort: 720 deliveries assessed over 1 year at a third-level maternity hospital in northeastern Brazil, focusing on pregnant women with preeclampsia.
finding: Compliance with MgSO4 recommendations for preeclampsia was initially low (74.7% underuse when needed) but significantly improved after the implementation of the WHO Safe Childbirth Checklist, with the use of MgSO4 in women with severe features increasing from 19.1% to 34.2%.
